description: This Java source file defines the CatalogUrlServlet class, a servlet responsible for handling catalog-related URL requests in the OFBiz framework. It processes URL path info to determine product and category IDs, sets request attributes accordingly, and forwards requests to appropriate control paths. It also provides static utility methods for constructing catalog URLs based on request data or parameters.

classes.name: CatalogUrlServlet
classes.description: Servlet class handling catalog URL parsing and URL construction for product and category pages.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Handles POST HTTP requests by delegating to doGet method.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Processes GET requests to parse URL info, identify product or category IDs, set request attributes, and forward to relevant control paths.

methods.name: makeCatalogUrl
methods.description: Constructs a catalog URL using request, product ID, and category trail data.

methods.name: makeCatalogUrl
methods.description: Constructs a catalog URL given context path, breadcrumb trail, product ID, and category IDs.
